title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
synopsis: After the defeat of the Demon King, elf mage Frieren reflects on her brief time with her former party and begins a new journey to better understand humanity and the meaning of life.
review: A thoughtful fantasy story with beautiful atmosphere, memorable character moments, and a moving exploration of time, loss, and connection.

title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity lives behind walls to protect themselves from man-eating Titans, but the truth about the world is far more complex and devastating than anyone imagined.
review: Incredible plotting and foreshadowing. The way the mystery unfolds and the moral questions it raises in the final seasons elevate it beyond typical action anime.

title: Oshi no Ko
synopsis: A doctor and his patient are reincarnated as the twin children of a beloved idol, navigating the dark underbelly of the entertainment industry.
review: A brilliant blend of industry critique and supernatural mystery. The first arc is a perfect hook. The genre-switching keeps things fresh.

title: Solo Leveling
synopsis: Sung Jin-Woo, the weakest E-rank hunter, gains a unique system that lets him level up infinitely, transforming from prey into the most powerful hunter in the world.
review: An absolute page-turner. The progression system and escalating stakes make every arc feel earned. The art improves dramatically over time, reaching jaw-dropping levels in the final chapters.

title: The Beginning After The End
synopsis: A powerful king reincarnates into a magical world as a baby, retaining his memories. He navigates childhood while building toward an extraordinary new life.
review: Great world-building and character growth. The art is consistently gorgeous. The pacing dips in the middle but recovers strongly.

title: Tower of God
synopsis: A boy named Bam enters a mysterious tower to find his friend, climbing floors that test strength, intelligence, and willpower against other climbers.
review: Massive and creative world with deep lore. The early seasons are peak webtoon storytelling. The art starts rough but evolves beautifully.

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
synopsis: When the world transforms into the setting of a web novel only Kim Dokja read to completion, he uses his unique knowledge to survive and protect his companions.
review: One of the most clever narrative structures in manhwa. The meta-commentary on storytelling is brilliant, and the character bonds are deeply emotional.

title: The Greatest Estate Developer
synopsis: Kim Suho, a civil engineering student, wakes up as Lloyd Frontera, a disgraced noble whose family is drowning in debt. Using his engineering knowledge and magical construction abilities, he develops innovative infrastructure and transforms the territory to secure a prosperous future.
review: GOATED MANHWA KAWKAWKAWK LUCU BANGET LAGI SEMUAN.

title: Grand Blue
synopsis: Iori Kitahara begins his freshman year at Izu University and moves into his uncle's scuba diving shop, Grand Blue, hoping to enjoy an ideal college life. Instead, he gets caught up with a rowdy group of upperclassmen whose wild drinking parties lead to chaotic and hilarious situations, complicating his plans for a normal university experience.
review: cocok buat lu yang kehidupanya ancur ancuran, komedinya sangat membantu lu buat tertawa, romance tipis tipis juga

title: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War
synopsis: Miyuki Shirogane, the brilliant student council president of Shuchiin Academy, and Kaguya Shinomiya, the wealthy and talented vice president, have secretly developed feelings for each other. However, both are too proud to confess, believing that doing so would mean losing their pride. Their relationship becomes a battle of wits as each tries to make the other confess first through clever schemes and hilarious daily antics.
review: ROMCOM TERBAIK NO DEBATE, ribut kita kalo gasuka

title: Haikyuu!!
synopsis: Shouyou Hinata dreams of becoming a great volleyball player after being inspired by the legendary Little Giant. Despite his short stature, Hinata joins Karasuno High School to pursue his dream, only to discover that his former rival, Tobio Kageyama, is now his teammate. The two must overcome their differences, improve their skills, and work together with the rest of the team to compete against the strongest high school volleyball teams in Japan.
review: gw sebut ini best sports manga. Belom ada yg setara menurut gw selain Slam Dunk yang emang peak tapi ini tu juga peak

title: Fated To Be Loved By Villains
synopsis: A veteran player of the game Savior Rising finds himself inhabiting the body of Dawood Campbell, a powerless noble living on the outskirts of society. Hoping to live quietly and avoid attention, he instead encounters Elnore Elinarize la Tristan, the game's final boss and vessel of the Grey Demon. This meeting grants him two special abilities: Desperate Survival, which makes him stronger when his chances of survival decrease, and Deadly Charm, which attracts people with Evil Traits. As he becomes entangled with Elnore and other Demon vessels, Dawood must use his veteran gaming knowledge to overcome dangerous challenges while navigating the growing attention of those drawn to him.
review: ampas sih, pantes di axed wkwkkw

title: I Killed the Academy Player
synopsis: The protagonist has killed the player of the academy, a person he considers an extremely irritating bastard. As the story unfolds in an academy setting filled with action and fantasy, he must face the consequences of his actions and navigate the challenges that follow.
review: Harem pada umumnya, kurang di writing sama pacing yang keliatan aneh banget

title: All My Alter Egos Are Tycoons
synopsis: Han Sunghyun loses his family in a random attack by superhumans and isolates himself due to the trauma. One day, he awakens the ability to control avatars that can venture into dangerous worlds while he stays home and focuses on growing stronger. As his avatars develop across dimensions, races, and professions, Han Sunghyun begins hunting superhumans who abuse their powers.
review: Konsepnya menarik dia punya banyak avatar di tiap dunia, cmn konfliknnya makin lama makin gajelas

title: I Took Over the Academy With a Single Sashimi Knife
synopsis: Once known as the greatest swordsman in the country, the protagonist finds himself inside a mobile game he had only played a few times. Blessed by the Sword God, he gains extraordinary swordsmanship abilities, but there is a catch: the only weapon he can use is a sashimi knife. With the power to become a Sword Saint for just one minute a day, he must use his limited time and skill to overcome the challenges of the academy.
review: ini diawal bagus banget, nge hook nya tu bagus konsepnya HIGH RISK HIGH REWARD, tapi makin lama makin gajelas konfliknya

title: Infinite Mage
synopsis: Shirone was abandoned in a stable as a child and raised by ordinary people. Born with an innate ability to learn and write, he discovers the wonder of magic during a visit to the city and dreams of becoming a mage. However, in a world ruled by rigid social barriers, his journey is filled with cruelty and challenges. Before reaching adulthood, Shirone begins to uncover the harsh realities of the world as he pursues his dream of becoming a great mage.
review: PEAKKKKK, one of the best writing terutama di power systemnya gokil ni manhwa. Pacingnya tu di 100ch awal bagus banget.

title: Magic Academy's Genius Blinker
synopsis: Baek Yuseol is considered one of the weakest characters in a fantasy game because he cannot use ordinary magic. After a bad ending destroys 90% of the Aether World, he is suddenly transported into the game and tasked with achieving the True Ending. His only ability is Blink, a teleportation skill that seems insignificant compared to the magic wielded by the geniuses of Stella Academy. Using this unique ability, Baek Yuseol must survive academy life, overcome dangerous challenges, and work toward saving the world.
review: I LOVE THE MC SO MUCH, dia tu serasa NPC tapi MC gitu dah, trus char Haremnya tidak SEBURUK HAREM MANHWA TYPE SHI LAIN NYA.

title: A Disaster-Class Hero Has Returned
synopsis: As the world is consumed by darkness and monsters emerge from mysterious dungeons, humanity faces the threat of extinction. Awakened hunters rise to fight these monsters, and among them are thirteen powerful heroes known as the Zodiac Saints. This story follows one of these legendary heroes and his journey in a world on the brink of destruction.
review: Actually a good manhwa, but the story terlalu repetitive, the MC is too OP and the story is too predictable. The art is good tho.

title: Pick Me Up (Infinite Gacha)
synopsis: Loki, a top-ranked player in the notoriously difficult mobile gacha game Pick Me Up, suddenly finds himself transformed into a low-level hero inside the game. Now trapped in a world where heroes must fight deadly battles to clear dungeons, he must lead a team, develop his abilities, and survive increasingly dangerous challenges. With every battle carrying the risk of permanent death, Loki must use his experience and strategic thinking to overcome the game's brutal trials and find a way back to his original world.
review: a good writing, nice concept, great art, great power system, but the pacing is too slow dan kadang kelamaan nya kerasa banget anjir.

title: Terminally-Ill Genius Dark Knight
synopsis: Yoo Chan, a young man who has suffered from a terminal illness since childhood, has spent much of his life playing a notoriously difficult fantasy RPG. One day, the game becomes his reality, and he finds himself inhabiting the body of Nox von Reinharber, the worst villain in the game's first part. Trapped in a dangerous world where every decision matters, Yoo Chan must use his knowledge of the game to survive and find a way to reach the story's ending alive.
review: good story, good development terutama di social nya MC

title: The Regressed Mercenary's Machinations
synopsis: Ghislain Perdium, the Mercenary King and one of the strongest men on the continent, launches a war to avenge his family. His revenge proceeds smoothly until he is unexpectedly killed by Idun. Believing his life has ended, Ghislain awakens in his younger body before his family falls into ruin. Given a second chance, he sets out to change the course of events, correct the mistakes of his previous life, and prevent his family's downfall.
review: ini writing, pacing nya bagus banget, MINUSNYA kaya ga niat di lanjutin banget sama studionya padahal.

title: Archmage Restaurant
synopsis: A man who dreams of becoming a famous chef is transported to a world filled with monsters and magic after an accident. Instead of opening his own restaurant, he is forced to join the military and spends fifteen years fighting in a war. After finally achieving his dream of becoming a restaurant owner, he begins a new chapter of his life as an archmage who serves delicious meals in a fantasy world.
review: komedi tipu getah anying, gw nangis mulu baca side story char yg jadi slice of life nya

title: Revenge of the Iron-Blooded Sword Hound
synopsis: Vikir, the loyal hunting dog of the powerful Baskerville family, is rewarded for his service with execution by guillotine. However, death grants him an unexpected second chance, sending him back to an earlier point in his life. Remembering the betrayal and suffering he endured, Vikir abandons his former loyalty and vows to take revenge on Hugo Baskerville. Armed with his memories and determination, he begins a new path to change his fate and destroy those who wronged him.

title: The Extra's Academy Survival Guide
synopsis: After possessing the body of a third-rate villainous extra in his favorite game, the protagonist has no desire to become a hero or pursue grand ambitions. All he wants is to live a quiet and peaceful life. Unfortunately, the world of the game is far more dangerous than he expected, forcing him to rely on his knowledge and resourcefulness to survive. Determined to make it to the end of the story, he must find his own way to endure the academy's challenges without following the protagonist's path.
review: manhwa akademi template yang LEBIH bagus dari si siapa

title: The Legendary Hero Is an Academy Honors Student
synopsis: Five thousand years ago, the legendary hero Kyle defeated Erebos, the origin of evil, during the Age of Despair. After reincarnating as Leo with all his memories intact, he discovers that his name has been erased from the Hero Record, a divine record of heroic achievements, and that modern society considers him fictional. Determined to uncover the truth, Leo enrolls at Lumene Academy, a prestigious hero academy that safeguards the Hero Record. He aims to become the academy's top student and discover why history has forgotten him.
review: SUMPAH, ini baru writing dialog yang bagus banget, gw suka banget kalau manhwa punya kata kata indah kaya di Manhwa ini, ceritanya juga ga kaleng, konsep dungeon yang time reversed itu gila keren juga, MC nya juga ga se idiot itu, dan emg goated juga

title: Regressing as the Reincarnated Bastard of the Sword Clan
synopsis: Theo Ragnar belongs to the mighty Ragnar clan, a grand ducal family renowned for its ancient history, powerful Dragon Knights, and dominion over the Northern Wall and Winter Mountains. Despite his lineage, Theo is determined to claim the clan's throne and break free from the cursed chains that bind him. Relying on his own strength and resolve, he sets out to overcome the obstacles surrounding his birth and change his destiny within one of the continent's most powerful families.

title: I Became the Genius Bastard of a Noble Dark Clan
synopsis: After fighting alongside a Hero's Party and suffering a fatal injury, Chris wishes to be reborn into a wealthy family. His wish comes true when he awakens as Christian van Baren Kazar, the infamous and seemingly useless illegitimate son of an immensely powerful dark magic clan. However, Christian is destined to die in just two years, and surviving that fate is only the beginning, as he must also prevent the world's destruction. Determined to enjoy his new life of wealth and luxury, Chris decides to seize control of the clan and become the Demon King himself, relying on his extraordinary genius to overcome the challenges ahead.

title: Star-Embracing Swordmaster
synopsis: Vlad is an orphan living in the slums who dreams of becoming a knight. After being struck by black lightning, he begins hearing a mysterious voice. His life changes dramatically when he encounters a knight wielding blue moonlight, setting him on a path toward a world far beyond the slums. Though he begins as a dim star in the night sky, Vlad is determined to rise and shine through his own strength and ambition.
review: ini representin KNIGHT banget, ASLI FRESH CONCEPT DAN MC GA DIBIKIN JADI OP MAMPUS, every char has their own development :))))

title: Ranker's Return (Remake)
synopsis: During the early days of the virtual reality game Arena, MeleeGod was its strongest ranker. At the height of his fame, he deleted his character and suddenly left the game. Years later, his family's financial troubles force him to return to Arena. Starting over with a new character, he must use his former experience and exceptional gaming skills to rise through the ranks once again and help his family recover.
review: Great remake with improved art and story pacing. The character development is well done and the action scenes are exciting.

title: Swordmaster's Youngest Son
synopsis: Jin Runcandel is the youngest son of the prestigious Runcandel clan, a family renowned for producing powerful swordmasters. Despite his lineage, he is considered a failure and is eventually cast out. After meeting a tragic end, Jin receives a second chance at life and regains the opportunity to change his fate. Armed with memories of his previous life and a stronger determination, he sets out to master the sword, uncover the secrets surrounding his family, and claim his rightful place among the world's greatest warriors.
review: actually i love the 1st 30 chapters, but lama lama boring bacanya mc gampang kena powercreep ah bete

title: Childhood Friend of the Zenith
synopsis: Gu Yangcheon once served the Heavenly Demon as a Demonic Human, committing countless crimes under his influence. After the Orthodox factions defeat the Heavenly Demon, Gu is captured and forced to face the consequences of his actions. Before dying, he reveals information about the Demon Cult to Wi Seol-Ah, bound by the connection they share. For reasons he cannot explain, Gu then regresses to the time when he first met her. title: The Heavenly Demon Can't Live a Normal Life
synopsis: Baek Joong-Hyuk, the Heavenly Demon, awakens in the body of Roman Dimitry, the eldest son of the Dimitry family. In his new life, Roman is regarded as a fool and is constantly overshadowed by his younger brother. However, the world has gravely underestimated the person he has become. Carrying the overwhelming will and strength of the Heavenly Demon, Roman refuses to live according to other people's expectations and begins to reshape the world around him.

title: Necromancer Academy's Genius Summoner

Simon Follentia is a young necromancer with extraordinary hidden talent who is recruited into a prestigious necromancer academy. As he begins his training, Simon discovers the true extent of his abilities. However, his exceptional talent attracts unexpected attention and leads to complications that could change his life and the world around him.
review: seangkatan sama Shirou (infinite mage) tapi ini lebi kureng dan PACE nya kadang cepet kadang lemot dan gw kurang suka sama artnya agak tidak nyaman.

title: The Novel's Extra (Remake)
synopsis: Kim Hajin wakes up in a world he recognizes, only to discover that he is trapped inside the unfinished novel he created. Instead of becoming the protagonist, he finds himself inhabiting the body of an insignificant extra character. His only apparent way to survive is to stay close to the original storyline, but he soon realizes that this world differs from the one he wrote. As unexpected changes unfold, Hajin must adapt to a reality that no longer follows his plans.
review: KING GWE KING HAJIN, how the author can make a story about a guy who is an extra in his own novel and make it interesting is beyond me, the writing is good, the pacing is good, the art is good, the character development is good, the world building is good, everything is good.

title: Mercenary Enrollment
synopsis: Yu Ijin is the sole survivor of a plane crash that left him stranded in a foreign land as a child. Forced to survive, he spends ten years becoming a highly skilled mercenary. When he finally returns to his hometown, Ijin reunites with his family and attempts to live an ordinary life as a student. However, his dangerous past and exceptional combat abilities continue to draw him into conflicts, forcing him to protect the people he cares about.

Determined never to be controlled again, Roan resolves to forge his destiny through his swordsmanship and eliminate anyone who stands in his way, even if that opponent is a god.

title: I'm Not That Kind of Talent
synopsis: Deon Hardt is a frail man who can barely withstand even the slightest pressure and is often mistaken for someone far more terrifying than he really is. Due to a series of misunderstandings, the Demon King believes Deon is a powerful warrior who killed the legendary Hero. Unbeknownst to Deon, he displays a completely different and frightening personality when drunk, creating even more confusion around his true nature. As these misunderstandings spiral out of control, his life becomes an unpredictable mix of comedy, danger, and dark fantasy.
review: GOOD STORY, tentang salah paham WKWKKWK ini lucu banget anjir

title: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player
synopsis: People between the ages of fifteen and twenty-five around the world are forced to participate in a deadly game consisting of twenty rounds. Ryu Min reaches the entrance to the final round alone, only to discover that he cannot proceed without a team of five. Now facing his hundredth and final regression, he uses the knowledge gained from his previous ninety-nine attempts to recruit the teammates he needs. With everything at stake, Ryu Min must overcome the challenges of the death game and find a way to reach its conclusion.

synopsis: Inside a mysterious tower resembling an RPG dungeon, Kim Gong-ja lives an ordinary life while envying the famous hunters around him. title: I Obtained a Mythic Item

title: Be the Actor
